chapter_title_en: Stirrings Beyond the Seas—Extreme Yin Ancestor
chapter_seo_title: Void Heaven Palace Chapter: Extreme Yin Ancestor’s Delight & Barbarian Beard’s Entrance
chapter_meta_description: Han Li enters the floating palace and is caught between a vengeful elder, a scheming old ghost, and a Nascent Soul whose delight at seeing him is deeply unsettling.
og_title: The Void Heaven Palace Opens—Han Li Walks Into a Room Full of Knives
og_description: Extreme Yin Ancestor, the Profound Bone Saint, Elder Miao, and two Nascent Soul seniors all focus on Han Li the moment he enters. No fighting—just high-stakes positioning for the treasure hunt to come.
twitter_title: Han Li enters the Void Heaven Palace and every gaze is already a threat.
twitter_description: Extreme Yin Ancestor smiles at Han Li like he’s found a long-lost prize. The Profound Bone Saint wants a partnership. Elder Miao wants revenge. And two Nascent Soul seniors are casually discussing Barbarian Beard’s arrival for the Longevity Fruit. The seating is done; the bloodbath is just waiting to start.

lore_anchors.definition: A floating jade palace in the sky that opens only once every three hundred years; a high-risk dungeon for cultivators seeking ancient treasures and rare spirit medicines.
A thousand-year-old ghost cultivator who exists as a Profound Soul Body; the former master of Extreme Yin Island’s founder, and a cunning, dangerous partner for anyone foolish enough to trust him.
The Nascent Soul patriarch of Extreme Yin Island; cold, calculating, and far more interested in Han Li than any Core Formation cultivator has a right to be.
A rare spirit fruit that can extend a cultivator’s lifespan; sought by Barbarian Beard to refine Longevity Pills and cheat death for another fifty or sixty years.
A feared Nascent Soul senior known for his brutal combat style; headed to the Void Heaven Palace to find Longevity Fruit before his lifespan runs out.
A fragment of a cloth map that serves as both a navigational guide and an entry token for the Void Heaven Palace; possessing one grants access to the palace.

In the xianxia cultivation hierarchy, Nascent Soul is a qualitative leap above Core Formation. A late Core Formation cultivator risks instant death if caught in a real fight with even an early Nascent Soul senior—raw power disparity is near absolute.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Extreme Yin Ancestor delighted to see Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The narrative deliberately leaves this ambiguous—his hidden interest signals that Han Li is connected to a larger scheme (likely tied to the Heaven Vial or the Blood Forbidden Trial’s aftermath) that the Ancestor expects to exploit.

cultural_notes_faq.q: If the Void Heaven Palace opens only once every 300 years, why is everyone here now?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the timing aligns with a generation of cultivators whose lifespans are running out; those who miss this window will never see the next opening, so the stakes are existential for the oldest participants.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Profound Bone Saint trustworthy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Absolutely not. He is a thousand-year-old ghost who sacrificed his physical form for vengeance; every word he speaks is a probe, every offer a trap. Han Li’s non-committal response is the correct play.
